name: homePos
meaning: home position: CannonBall_Reset passes &this->homePos to SetPosition (vtable +0x1c) at 0x4a1b50-0x4a1b5c

name: curPos
meaning: pos copied at the start of each flight step (the kill test uses this previous-frame position); set by msg 0x3382

name: targetPos
meaning: pipe entry point (msg 0x3383, approached in state 4); msg 0x3384 overwrites it with the current pos (transit end)

name: camGoal
meaning: chase-camera end position for pipe transit (msg 0x3385: target - dir/8, vertical target-200, clamped +-200); copied to camPos on a 0x3381 from a non-cannon sender

name: launchDir
meaning: launch vector; velocity = launchDir*1000/0xfff u/s (a 4.12 unit vector gives ~1000 u/s); set by 0x3381/0x3383/0x3385/0x3389/0x338a

name: velocity
meaning: units/s for this frame (per-state formula)

name: frameDelta
meaning: Vec3s_ScaleByDt(velocity), the move applied this frame; stored as hitDir when the lifetime expires

name: homingTarget
meaning: state-2 target point (msg 0x338a from Rook: Wolf pos, 120 up)

name: distSq
meaning: state 4: squared distance to targetPos this frame

name: prevDistSq
meaning: state 4: previous distSq; entry completes once distSq >= prevDistSq

name: pipe
meaning: sender of 0x3383; gets when the entry point is reached

name: launcher
meaning: cannon that owns the ball (class 97/146/178 sender of 0x3381/0x3382/0x338a); gets msg 0x4f (arg hitClassId) when the explosion ends, and msg 0xe on a Hive hit

name: hitClassId
meaning: class id of what the ball hit (0xffff = static geometry); argument of msg 0x4f

name: contact
meaning: Collide_ResolveMove output (0xc0 floorObj, 0xc4 wallObj, 0xc8 movableObj, 0xd4 wallNormalMean); 0x1c bytes

name: state
meaning: CannonBallState

name: cameraReleased
meaning: 1 after msg 0x3386; suppresses CannonBall_UpdateChaseCamera; cleared by SetState(0) and Reset

name: lethal
meaning: msg 0x3388 arg; enables the state-1 proximity kill (CanonSheep sends 1, CanonSimple 0)

name: firedByCannon
meaning: 1 when 0x3381 came from class 97/146/178; the sweep then passes through cannon objects (97/105/146)

name: hitPipe
meaning: set by the sweep on touching a Pipe/Pipe2 wall; cleared by 0x3383/SetState(1)/Reset; still set on the next state-1 frame -> explode

name: fxActive
meaning: explosion/splash body is animating; cleared when its anim ends

name: hitWolf
meaning: 1 when the ball killed the Wolf: it follows the Wolf during the explosion, stays drawn, and plays no explosion sound or model

name: explodeTimerMs
meaning: state 5 countdown, 2500 ms, g_dtMs

name: pipes
meaning: Pipe (class 96) objects found at Init; each gets msg 0x4f at the end of an explosion

name: pipes2
meaning: Pipe2 (class 163) objects found at Init; also get msg 0x4f

name: pipeCount
meaning: count for pipes[]

name: pipe2Count
meaning: count for pipes2[]

name: flightTimeMs
meaning: PARABOLIC flight time, g_dtMs accumulated in state 1

name: lifetimeMs
meaning: PROPERTY LIFETIME (level data 5000/7000)

name: lifeLeftMs
meaning: state-1 countdown from lifetimeMs; at <= 0 the ball explodes in mid-air

name: camPos
meaning: chase-camera eye; clamped to +-200 of the ball in flight

name: transitStart
meaning: pipe entry point (set when state 4 completes); start of the state-6 interpolation

name: camTransitStart
meaning: camPos at msg 0x3384

name: transitDelta
meaning: exit - entry for state 6

name: camTransitDelta
meaning: camGoal - camTransitStart

name: camPitch
meaning: chase-camera pitch passed to Camera_StartScripted

name: camYaw
meaning: chase-camera yaw

name: transitStartTime
meaning: g_gameTime at msg 0x3384

name: transitDuration
meaning: msg 0x3384 arg, in g_gameTime ticks (1/4096 s)

name: ownsCamera
meaning: msg 0x3387 arg (CanonSimple 1, Rook 0); enables the chase camera; releases it after the explosion; cleared on a Hive hit

name: trailSmokeFx

name: trailSmokeParams
meaning: Emitter_UpdateDrift params {s32 50, -10, 0xa30, 0x146; u16 size 40->100; u8 0}

name: debrisSmokeParams
meaning: drift params {50,-10,0xa30,0x146; size 20->50 (reset by SetState(5), shrunk 1 per frame in state 5); 0}

name: trailBubbleParams
meaning: Emitter_UpdateRiseToCap params {s32 -120, 0xa30, 0x146; u16 15; u16 cap 0; u8 frame 2}

name: debrisBubbleParams
meaning: rise params {-120, 0xa30, 0x32f; 10; cap 0; 2}

name: debrisPos
meaning: explosion debris positions (start at the ball pos)

name: debrisVel
meaning: debris velocities, Rand_Range(-800,800) per axis; wall bounce = normal/5

name: gravityTicks
meaning: state 1 PARABOLIC: flightTimeMs/40 (x WEIGHT = downward u/s); state 5: +1 per frame (debris gravity x15/2)

name: gravityWeight
meaning: PROPERTY WEIGHT (gravity multiplier)

name: parabolic
meaning: PROPERTY PARABOLIC (gravity on in state 1)

name: rumbleMotors
meaning: {0xfe,0xff} passed to Pad_Rumble_stub

name: explosionFx
meaning: embedded explosion/splash model (WAR_IDO_AEXPLOS1 = 3); anim 1 undirected, anim 2 oriented by hitDir; pos at +0x1028, yaw +0x1032, anim flags +0x107e

name: explosionRecord
meaning: record synthesised by Scn_BuildRecordFromExport(3)

name: hasExplosionFx
meaning: 1 if the export existed and explosionFx was initialised

name: inWater
meaning: set once the ball enters a g_waterZones box in flight (bubbles on; no second splash)

name: noHitDir
meaning: static hit with a zero normal: the explosion plays undirected anim 1

name: hitDir
meaning: orientation for the anim-2 explosion (hit normal or last frameDelta)

name: explodeSound
meaning: Sound_Play(0x44) handle
